notes.subject: feat(btw): follow-up questions, send thread to main chat, higher limits
notes.summary: The /btw panel now supports follow-up questions in the side thread, replaces 'Add to conversation' with 'Send to chat' to send your message plus the side thread to the main agent, and raises per-question limits to 25 turns, 50 tool calls and 10 minutes.

notes.subject: fix(agent): reject same-batch overlapping spawns and surface write-lease waits
notes.summary: Background agents spawned in one batch with overlapping owned paths are now rejected with workspace_conflict, writers waiting on workspace write access show as queued with the blocker, and read-only agents get clearer guidance about scripts.
